addProxyHelp: Add proxy sleeve; long synthetic A-RVol supports monthly blends
sleeveCaption: Choose sleeves and starting weights. With A-RVol, weights drift without transfers between sleeves; monthly-only portfolios retain their monthly weight reset.
savedListError: Saved portfolios could not be loaded.
emptySaved: No portfolios saved in your account. Save one on the Portfolio page or load a JSON file below.
loadCaption: Loads sleeve choices and weights; capital is converted from saved ILS to USD using the saved FX rate. Browser defaults are unchanged. Unavailable backtest strategies will be flagged.
deepLoadCaption: Loads compatible strategy proxies and weights, not actual ETF/ILS history. Unsupported variants are rejected. Saved capital is converted to USD; your default portfolio stay unchanged.
proxyCaption: Bundled strategy-level monthly returns and signal histories extend beyond the available ETF/TASE price histories. Results are proxy backtests, not security-level historical returns.
liveOrigin: Existing live loaders; no cached/live price splice or proxy substitution.
benchmarkHelp: The global option uses nominal USD ACWI proxy returns from 1970. Early history uses substitute assets; it is not actual ACWI or ISAC ETF history throughout.
weightWarning: Sleeve weights total {total:.2f}%. Set them to exactly 100% to run the portfolio backtest.
deepWeightWarning: Sleeve weights total {total:.2f}%. Set them to exactly 100% to run the proxy backtest.
positivePortfolio: Set one or more positive sleeve weights totaling exactly 100% to run the portfolio backtest.
positiveDeep: Set one or more positive proxy sleeve weights totaling exactly 100%.
duplicateProxy: Choose each proxy strategy at most once.
duplicateIds: Each sleeve must have its own row identifier.
dailySingle: Daily supplied proxies support a single strategy only, not blends.
tooManyProxy: The proxy sleeve limit has been reached.
noReplay: Reference replay is available in Single strategy mode only.
needsRvol: Quarterly RVol cap requires an A-RVol sleeve.
capOrder: RVol reset target must be below its cap.
transferDeposits: Sleeve transfers are not available with monthly contributions yet.
chooseSaved: Choose a saved portfolio or a portfolio JSON file, not both.
missingSaved: The saved portfolio is unavailable. Reload saved portfolios and try again.
invalidSaved: Choose a valid version-1 saved portfolio with known strategies, positive sleeve weights totaling 100%, and positive saved capital and FX.
invalidSavedDeep: No compatible bundled Deep History for this saved portfolio. Choose its proxy manually; no variant was substituted.
savedErrors: Choose a version-1 saved portfolio JSON file.
Saved portfolio contains an unknown strategy.
Saved sleeve weights must be positive and finite.
Saved capital and FX rate must be positive and finite.
Saved portfolio maps to duplicate proxy sleeves.
dateRange: The requested dates are outside the common executable holding periods or end is before start.
invalidResult: The engine returned no finite completed result. Check the settings and data range.
sizeError: Display response exceeds the size limit; try a shorter date range.
mixedCaption: Applies only when a daily sleeve such as A-RVol is included. Transfers are checked at the stated close and are included in fees, turnover, and the sleeve-level realized-gain tax estimate.
taxCaption: Tax applies to realized sales. With A-RVol, strategy tax bases and loss carryforwards stay separate by sleeve; optional sleeve transfers use a separate, auditable sleeve-level realized-gain estimate, without cross-sleeve loss offsets. This is a simplified tax model.
dailyTax: Israeli capital-gains tax (unavailable for this import)
dailyCaption: The earlier daily-signal import lacks trade values and remains standalone only, without tax or extra fees.
proxyTax: Tax is applied using the existing realized-gain engine. Because these files contain strategy-level returns rather than security-level prices, tax realization at allocation changes is an explicit proxy approximation. Benchmark: {benchmark}.
syntheticTax: Synthetic tax estimate: A-RVol's daily sales are reconstructed from frozen inputs; other sleeves use monthly allocation-change proxies. Monthly weight-reset sales are taxed too. Average cost and separate loss carryforwards by sleeve; no cross-sleeve loss offsets, FX/indexation or terminal liquidation. Modeled cash gains are taxed on sale, not as interest. Extra trading fees remain unsupported.
unsupportedFees: Additional trading-fee assumptions are not supported for this daily proxy import and are not applied. DCA remains available; the long synthetic option also supports modeled CGT.
dateHelp: Leave dates empty to use the full shared history. Available holding periods are confirmed by Python when Run is pressed.
common: Common executable holding periods: {lower} to {upper}. The start date reflects the shortest available sleeve history.
monthlyReset: Monthly sleeve rebalancing resets sleeve weights to targets at each month-end and uses only shared available history.
mixedNone: Initial sleeve weights only: no transfers or monthly resets between sleeves. Israel sleeves execute at next-session closing/NAV prices; US A-RVol executes at the next open. Monthly sleeves execute at next-session close. Portfolio values are marked daily at the close.
mixedCap: Quarterly RVol-cap review: when the selected sleeve exceeds its cap at quarter-end, it is reset to the chosen target and the other sleeves receive the proceeds in their target proportions.
mixedAnnual: Annual target-weight reset: all sleeves are restored to their starting target weights at each calendar year-end close.
mixedTax: Fees apply per actual buy/sell side. Strategy taxes use each sleeve's own ledger; transfer taxes are a sleeve-level realized-gain approximation, without cross-sleeve loss offsets, FX/indexation, or terminal liquidation. All sleeves must share one execution currency and calendar; no USD/ILS conversion is assumed.
holdingPeriods: Holding periods: {lower} through {upper}. SPY is the buy-and-hold benchmark.
proxyWarning: Proxy result: the bundled CSV contains strategy-level returns and signals, not historical security prices. Capital-gains realization at allocation changes is therefore an approximation.
blendWarning: Proxy blend: exact monthly returns are combined over shared history, with monthly sleeve weight resets. Daily portfolio drawdown is unavailable. When tax is enabled, A-RVol uses reconstructed daily sales and other sleeves use monthly allocation-change approximations; reset sales are included. Extra fees remain unsupported with synthetic A-RVol.
syntheticMetrics: Comparable metrics use complete monthly periods; daily drawdown uses every synthetic daily NAV. No daily benchmark observations are invented. Modeled sale events: {count}. Tax is a simplified USD realized-gain estimate; extra fees are unsupported.
dailyMetrics: Monthly return statistics. Daily maximum drawdown and realized-gain tax are unavailable from this import.
sourceCaption: Positions before and after each day's execution are source holdings, not today's live signal. Open trade-day returns combine old-position overnight and new-position intraday returns. The full source includes partial first and last months, excluded from benchmark comparisons.
sleeveFeeCaption: Aggregate returns exclude deposits and include order fees. Monthly-only per-sleeve statistics are before portfolio-level fees; orders are counted separately by sleeve, even when sleeves hold the same ETF.
dailySignals: Supplied daily signal changes (not monthly execution dates)
rollingCaption: Each point is the annualized compounded return for the preceding complete rolling period.
plainCaption: Plain buy-and-hold assets: actual available fund history only; no automatic proxy or pre-fund extension. Fund expenses are already embedded in prices.
plainStandIn: {asset}: {kind}. Any stand-in or pre-fund period belongs to the selected replacement/source, not verified actual fund history.
plainUnverified: {asset}: using {field}; dividend/distribution-adjusted total return is not verified.
